source.note: class.md Known divergences (name-start-reads-unit): mermaid.js rejects ``class `~A` `` because the backquoted name starts with `~`; here it adds the class `~A`, and the annotation statement for `A` names no class, so the input is rejected (class.md Rejections outside the grammar).
